answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the ember until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
